applyTo: "**"
---

- Always avoid over-engineering
  When implementing features or writing code, always prioritize simplicity and clarity. Avoid adding unnecessary complexity or over-engineering solutions.

- Always assess the impact of changes
  Before making changes to existing code, always assess the potential impact on other parts of the system to prevent unintended side effects.

- Virtual environment usage
  Always run code in existing virtual environment .venv
  When running Python code from VS Code (e.g. tests), always run it in the existing virtual environment located at `.venv` in the project root.
